entries.zh: 褒奖；称赞、颂扬。
entries.en: to praise, to commend, to extol.

entries.zh: 褒贬——并施称赞与贬斥（西语 echar 此处作“贬抑、贬下”解）。
entries.en: to praise and to censure together.

entries.zh: 因德行而厚加褒扬（尤指对地位低于己者）；宠爱、恩宠。
entries.en: to praise an inferior greatly for his virtue; to favor with praise.
entries.notes: M栏第二音节调符污损（T99），四栏字义一致，降级仅为音系栏缺损。

entries.zh: 称赞他／她（伊＝他）。
entries.en: to praise him (her).

entries.zh: 颂：称颂、颂扬。
entries.en: to laud, to praise solemnly.

entries.zh: 颂德：颂扬（他人之）德行。
entries.en: to extol someone's virtue.
entries.notes: M栏末音节标[残]且调符T99，R栏te与H栏“德”互证，义可定而栏有损。

entries.zh: 赞：附和他人的称美之辞、助成其赞美（“说得好”式的称赞）。
entries.en: to second another's praise; to assent with praise.
entries.notes: R栏单音节chan下记两枚调符（含T99），原稿音系栏有损，义据H/L定。

entries.zh: 赞美：与他人一同称美、称扬。
entries.en: to praise together with another; to extol.

entries.zh: 赞叹：附和他人之称赞而叹美。
entries.en: to praise in chorus; to extol with admiration.
entries.notes: M栏首音节调符污损（T99），L/H/R三栏一致。

entries.zh: 赞扬：公开张扬被称美者之德行。
entries.en: to extol publicly; to spread abroad the praise of someone.

entries.zh: 敬慕而称美；钦羡（原字作“羡”，取敬羡义）。
entries.en: to admire respectfully; to praise with reverence.
entries.notes: H栏“羡”与L栏respetando义有出入，M/R音写（Zoan/zuen）亦不密合，疑原字为“羨／尊”类，暂取敬羡义。

entries.zh: 自夸、自炫（西语栏仅存残片“api muy mo”，据下数条“品…”自夸句群定）。
entries.en: to boast, to vaunt oneself.
entries.notes: L栏仅存残片api muy mo，H栏单字“品”须靠下诸条自夸句群补义，语义无法确证。

entries.zh: 夸耀出身高贵、自抬门第。
entries.en: to boast of being of noble birth.
entries.notes: H栏“品頭皮”末字“皮”于义未安，或为方言词尾音写，L栏de noble明示门第义。

entries.zh: 夸说自己手艺／手段高明（buena mano＝好手、巧手）。
entries.en: to boast of a very good hand (skill, dexterity).

entries.zh: 夸耀自己力气大。
entries.en: to boast of one's strength.

entries.zh: 夸耀自己富有（字面“品伊富”＝评品他富）。
entries.en: to boast of being rich.

entries.zh: 夸口；自夸、自吹。
entries.en: to boast, to brag.

entries.zh: 歌以颂之；以歌咏称美。
entries.en: to praise in song; to sing someone's praises.
entries.notes: H栏“民歌”为名词短语而L栏为动词，取“歌以颂之”义调和；M/R音写（bin ko／mien co）与字合。

entries.zh: 因感恩而称美并抬举（荐拔：举荐、提拔）。
entries.en: to extol and raise up out of gratitude.
entries.notes: H栏第二字原件标[疑:拔/技]，“荐技”不成词，取“荐拔”举荐提拔义。

entries.zh: 吹嘘：替人张扬德行、传播名声（本义“吹气”，引申为吹捧）。
entries.en: to puff up; to extol and spread someone's fame.

entries.zh: 僭称：妄自称大、自命为大人物。
entries.en: to style oneself a great man; to usurp a title.
entries.notes: R栏首音节作choan，与H栏“僭”尖音不合，疑R栏音写有误；H/L义明确。

entries.zh: 偏护而称美（原稿并注参见 J. favorecer、ayudar 二条）；字作“噓”，吹捧义。
entries.en: to praise by favoring; see favorecer (to favor) and ayudar (to help); the character 噓 means to puff up.
entries.notes: M栏“J. Hu..r hey”残缺且混入参见标记，L栏末“A”疑为下一词头起首字母。
